queries.question: What deferred revenue did Apple report at 28 December 2024?
queries.consequence: Select concept and precision; never substitute current for total

queries.question: Did Apple collect 4.1 billion of new advances?
queries.consequence: 4.1 is A minus new-origin release plus other movements at displayed centres; no collection fact follows

queries.question: Is 3.7 billion all quarterly deferred-revenue recognition?
queries.consequence: Only opening-balance origin is specified; preserve unknown new-origin release

queries.question: How much of December deferred revenue is expected in less than a year?
queries.consequence: Expectation, not fixed cash due or all future revenue; retain December anchor and unknown intra-bucket timing

queries.question: What is the value of the excluded long-term undelivered services?
queries.consequence: Keep obligation/amount unknown; do not substitute zero or total deferred revenue

queries.question: Can Greater China iPhone revenue be obtained by multiplying total iPhone share by segment revenue?
queries.consequence: Two marginal tables plus qualitative exception do not identify the joint amount

queries.question: Does Services revenue measure customer gross App Store spending?
queries.consequence: Source describes retained net commission for these transactions; gross billings require separate facts

queries.question: Can FY2024 revenue minus FY2025Q1 revenue give FY2024 last nine months?
queries.consequence: The December 2024 quarter begins after the September 2024 year end
